runs.owner_transport: published synthetic in-process responses; no TLS or real upstream latency

methodology: Three interleaved rounds, same NAS/SSD, one bounded synthetic client at a time; no production data/media mounts; timings include native authorization/source/guard checks

conclusions.interpretation: PG keyword reads improved, not universal parity. Formal SQLite increases and tails remain; same-fixture paired control did not reproduce a stable short-read slowdown, which is not proof of no variation or no regression for every workload.

aggregation.formal: Median of each round p50/p95/p99/ops_s; all per-round values and raw latencies retained
aggregation.sequential_control: Median of each run metric across three runs per variant; raw latency samples retained separately
aggregation.paired_control: Median across three block-level metrics. Each block paired ratio is median(new_i/old_i), not ratio of unpaired medians
aggregation.formal_exclusions: Initialization, migrations, seed, warmups, signature validation, trace/profile, sequential/paired controls, rank/catalog laboratory; formal denominator remains 24 runs / 4560 samples

client_resources.scope: Client only; existing PG server CPU/memory and shared NAS background were not equalized

sqlite_full.failure_status: same 400-versus-403 failure independently reproduced on original e1 in prior batch

paired_sqlite_control.stderr_note: Both readers emitted the same Starlette TestClient import deprecation warning; no failure, no dependency change

catalog_interpretation: Observed direct catalog plan filters pg_class by relnamespace together with relname; planning 0.515 -> 0.162 ms and client median 0.9116 -> 0.45325 ms in isolated diagnostic. COUNT can prune pg_indexes.indexdef: no claim of saved indexdef reconstruction; not formal end-to-end timing.

ranking_laboratory.reason: Equivalent hit scores but broad/OR slower by roughly 9%; frozen runtime remains 45d8061

footprint.non_target_comparison_scope: Collected id/image/mount/status/policy snapshots only; not every non-target restart count was collected, so unchanged full lifecycle is not claimed

limits: 84c2f56 plus fixed shared 0.1.2 versus 45d8061 plus the same shared 0.1.2; not prior e1 baseline
Two Memory synthetic workloads only; Knowledge and Redis not rebenchmarked
Ordinary complete groups with facts/context features installed; not every automatic-history, semantic/model, workload or concurrency shape
Synthetic in-process owner responses preserve authority/barrier validation but exclude real Core/Platform TLS/network delay
Shared NAS scheduling/load persists; round medians and overlaps are descriptive, not a statistical proof of equivalence
Sequential/paired controls share one post-withdrawal 365-group SQLite fixture with 10 Python groups; cannot substitute for the full 30-match corpus, SourceAuthority barrier or write workloads
Two loaded readers in paired control each have 512MiB and CPU0-7 but only one active select; this is a separate resource/control configuration
SQLite trace includes FTS internal/trigger callback repetitions, not physical I/O; PG native counts exclude driver startup/implicit protocol and SQL-function internal statements
Candidate locally integrated through c4a75d6; production Q15 unchanged and candidate not deployed
